extracted.summary: A solicitor administering a Bath estate worth around £407,000, mostly the deceased's home, is seeking £19,500 to cover professional fees and tax pending the sale of the property.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for the estate you are administering. To take this further we would need confirmation of the grant of representation status, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities, details of any inheritance tax due and the relevant payment dates, and confirmation of the property's valuation and marketing position. Please also confirm the identities of the executors and that all of them support the application. Once we have reviewed that information we will come back to you with next steps. Nothing in this message should be taken as an offer of funding or an indication of terms.
